_doc: Effect keys the inert audit flags that are consumed another way.
Each entry says how, so a genuine regression is not hidden behind one.

waivers.nuclear_devices: Recorded as the counter project_effect:nuclear_devices, which the strike and stockpile paths read.
waivers.thermonuclear_devices: Recorded as the counter project_effect:thermonuclear_devices, read the same way.
waivers.power_source_coal: Descriptive label. The swap is implemented in converted_power_plant, matched on the project name.
waivers.ai_value: Descriptive hint on nazca_line, not an effect: the engine values improvements from their yields, and no valuation reads a data-supplied score. Left in the data because the shipped database carries it.
waivers.scenario_only: Descriptive marker. All eleven carriers are already `unbuildable: true`, which is the gate that actually keeps them out of an ordinary game; see the note at src/rules.rs:3137.

names.cinnamon: Zanzibar's two suzerain luxuries. They exist only as this grant, so data/resources.json has no row for them (Civ VI's RESOURCE_CINNAMON and RESOURCE_CLOVES are not placed on the map).
names.unknown: Sentinel terrain for a tile a hypothetical view has never seen. Not a ruleset row by design; player_view.rs writes it and the fog checks compare against it.

effect_reads.building_food: Generic district yield arm: district_building_yields reads all six yields, and today only building_gold and building_science are shipped.
effect_reads.citizen_faith: Generic specialist yield arm beside citizen_food, citizen_science, citizen_culture and the rest; no shipped building pays Faith per specialist.
effect_reads.powered_faith: Generic powered-building yield arm beside powered_science, powered_culture and the rest; no shipped building pays Faith when powered.
effect_reads.trade_food: Trade-route yield family: read beside trade_gold and trade_production. No shipped card pays Food on every route. Runtime modifier attachments can still carry the key.
effect_reads.domestic_trade_gold: See trade_food: the domestic slot of that family, pinned to zero by age_tests.rs.
effect_reads.international_trade_gold: See trade_food: the international slot of that family.
effect_reads.international_trade_production: See trade_food: the international slot of that family.
effect_reads.policy_trade_route_capacity: See trade_food: pinned to zero by age_tests.rs. Route capacity ships through gov_effects and wonders.
effect_reads.military_promotion: Fallback for modded named Great People, per the comment at the read; great_person_runtime_tests.rs pins it.
